name: Mitsuya Harunobu
source:
Parents lost to a fatal traffic accident, Harunobu tries to relieve his [url=/c697]sister’s[/url] burden. Still enrolled in high school and therefore ineligible for fulltime employment, he faithfully takes the role of a housekeeper who eases the breadwinner’s daily return from work. Though Harunobu has little interest and time for athletic activities, he possesses a natural aptitude for physical challenges.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320235028/http://www.erogereview.com/2011/06/07/gokuin-no-sentou//]Nargrakhan's review[/url].]
